title: Indicted
headline: PROMOTION BOSS INDICTED ON 34 COUNTS; PERP-WALKED PAST HIS OWN BILLBOARD
text: The feds came at 6am. You were wearing a robe with your own logo on it. Your lawyer says 'eight to twelve, out in five with good behavior'. The prison has a fight league. Of course it does.

title: Collapsed: Promotion Bankrupt
headline: CAGE PROMOTION GOES BELLY UP; FIGHTERS PAID IN EXPIRED ENERGY DRINKS
text: The checks bounced. Then the venue bounced you. The cage was repossessed and is now a batting cage in Tulsa. Your fighters scattered to rival leagues and bare-knuckle circles. You host a podcast now. Nineteen people listen.

title: Forced Out by the Board
headline: BOARD OUSTS PRESIDENT IN 7-MINUTE MEETING; REPLACEMENT IS A 29-YEAR-OLD MBA NAMED TRENT
text: The board met without you. Trent from strategy has your office now. He's replacing the cage with 'an immersive fan experience'. You took the golden parachute and the stapler.

title: Sold Out to the Desert Kingdom
headline: PROMOTION RELOCATES TO QASR IN $9 BILLION DEAL; PRESIDENT GIVEN A YACHT AND A NEW PASSPORT
text: The Kingdom made an offer nobody could refuse, so you didn't. The events are lavish, the cage is gold-plated, and you are no longer allowed to leave. The human rights reports come out every year. You don't read them.

title: Went Into Politics
headline: FIGHT BOSS ANNOUNCES SENATE RUN AT A CAGESIDE WEIGH-IN; PUNCHES OPPONENT'S CARDBOARD CUTOUT
text: You realized politics is just fight promotion with worse lighting. Your campaign slogan is 'I'LL PUT THEM IN THE CAGE'. You are polling at 41%. God help us all.

title: Slap League Forever
headline: MMA PROMOTION QUIETLY SHUTTERED; PRESIDENT GOES ALL-IN ON SLAPPING
text: The MMA business was hard. Slapping is easy. Two guys, one table, no defense. The doctors write angry letters. The ratings are incredible. You are the King of Slaps and nobody can take that from you.

title: The Fighters' Promoter
headline: LOWER VALUATION, HIGHER PAYCHECKS: THE PROMOTER FIGHTERS ACTUALLY LIKED
text: You paid people fairly. The valuation never hit the moon, the board grumbled, but fighters retired with their brains and their money. They named a gym after you. It's in a strip mall, but still.

title: Billion-Dollar Ghost
headline: PRESIDENT EXITS RICHER THAN GOD, HATED BY EVERYONE WHO EVER WORKED FOR HIM
text: You made the money. All of it. You sit in a mansion with 14 bathrooms and nobody calls. Your fighters' documentary about you is titled 'The Leech'. It won an Emmy.

title: The Legend
headline: THE MAN WHO BUILT THE SPORT TAKES A FINAL BOW
text: Hated, loved, sued, celebrated. You built the thing from a VFW hall into a global empire, and somehow you're not in prison. The Hall of Fame gave you a wing. You gave a 40-minute speech. They cut your mic at minute 31.

title: Middle of the Card
headline: PROMOTION CHIEF STEPS DOWN; 'IT WAS FINE,' SAYS EVERYONE
text: Ten years. Some wins, some losses, a lot of paperwork. You hand the keys to your successor and take a job as a color commentator. You are, by all accounts, fine.

title: The Third Man in the Cage
headline: DISGRACED PROMOTER REINVENTS HIMSELF AS A REFEREE; LETS EVERY FIGHT GO TOO LONG
text: After everything, you just wanted to be close to the action. You got your referee license through an online course. Your first fight, you stood there for 40 seconds while a man was unconscious. Nerm Bean called to say he was proud of you.
